description: This file implements the <check-errors> element for Apache OFBiz's MiniLang framework, specifically defining the CheckErrors class which extends MethodOperation to handle error checking logic during method execution.

classes.name: CheckErrors
classes.description: Represents the <check-errors> element, providing logic to check error messages and set error codes/messages within the method's environment.

methods.name: CheckErrors
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CheckErrors object based on an XML element and the associated SimpleMethod, validating attributes and setting up expandable strings.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the error-checking logic: retrieves error messages from environment, sets error info if messages are present, and returns false to halt execution if errors are found.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Retrieves the error code, expanding from the environment or defaulting if empty.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the CheckErrors instance, including its configured attributes.
